request_phase.name: first_request_to_last_response
request_phase.method: Request perf_counter timestamps mapped to wall time by mean of controller start/end clock offsets.

excluded: Remaining model normalization, RoPE, softmax, activations and elementwise gates
Special functions have separate counts where known, not arbitrary FLOP equivalents
Graph padding, masked implementation arithmetic and TP-replicated work
limitations: The catalog combines disjoint model-semantic families, not complete device execution.
Actual device routing totals match valid/padded row bounds for every observed call. Useful routed totals use host valid-token extents; per-expert useful distribution under padding is not isolated.
Attention lengths and recurrent eligibility are host-observed without same-run device validation.
No cross-run time denominator, effective FLOP/s, reference capacity or acceptance percentage is derived.
Draft vocabulary rows are source-mapped replay arguments, not internal kernel observations.
F remains partial. HBM and communication are from this same observer run; the host event filter is not a complete synchronized boundary for every non-MoE operator.
Convolution state-access offsets were not captured in r9; source-derived arithmetic does not establish a matched state-access reference.
All additional families are source/host-derived, not device FLOP counters; original evidence remains unchanged.
GDN H/O and scan are source/host-derived with CPU real-arithmetic equivalence tests; not device instruction counts or BF16 rounding equivalence.

hardware.scope: Observer-run device-wide physical traffic; not uninstrumented serving performance.
